summary.text: Rush Bricken is a Republican member of the Tennessee House of Representatives for District 47, where he has served since November 2018, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In the general election, Bricken is on the ballot with Mike Stein.

paragraphs.text: Rush Bricken was first elected to the Tennessee House of Representatives for District 47 in 2018 and took office on November 6, 2018.
In the 2023–2024 session he was vice chair of the Commerce Committee and also sat on the Civil Justice, State Government, and Fiscal Review committees.
